guidance.statement: Aspiring ~4x topline growth by FY27E to ₹26,000 Mn
Targeting a top line of INR 26,000 million for FY27 with a PAT margin in the range of 6% to 8%.

operating_notes.text: MoU with the Government of Gujarat covers a 5 GW solar cell plant in two phases (2 GW + 3 GW) and a 10 GW BESS facility, at an estimated project cost of ₹4,000 Cr including land and building.
Order book stated at over ₹4,000 Cr including EPC orders, covering 15-18 months of revenue pipeline.
FY26 saw over 200 EPC projects executed across solar parks, industrial, textiles and infrastructure.
Tadkeshwar, Gujarat module plant has 4 GW production capacity.
Total module capacity reached 4 GW in November 2025.
FY26 module sales crossed 1 gigawatt with overall capacity utilization at 70%.
Solex Energy awarded Top Performer in Kiwa PVEL 2026 PV Module Reliability Scorecard for Tapi R and Tapi Trans Dual series.
Unveiled TAPI RQ N-Type TOP-Con Quarter Cell solar module with output up to 670 Wp and efficiency up to 24.80%.

timeline.summary: On 1 May 2026 Solex Energy signed an MoU with the Government of Gujarat for a 5 GW solar cell plant (2 GW then 3 GW) and a 10 GW BESS facility, with an estimated project cost of ₹4,000 Cr.

On 8 May 2026 Solex Energy reported FY26 revenue from operations of ₹1,618.1 Cr, up 144.3% YoY, with Q4FY26 revenue of ₹885.5 Cr (up 248.1%), and put its order book at over ₹4,000 Cr covering 15-18 months.
Solex Energy Limited schedules Post Earnings Conference Call on May 18, 2026, at 11:00 AM IST to discuss Q4 & FY2026 results.
On May 16, 2026, Solex Energy released its Q4 and FY26 investor presentation, reporting a 143.9% jump in annual revenue to ₹1,621.1 Cr and a ₹3,400 Cr order book.
Solex Energy Limited shared the audio recording of its Post Earnings’ Conference Call held on May 18, 2026, via provided URL and company website.
On May 18, 2026, Solex Energy hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, guiding for ₹2,600 Cr revenue in FY27 and detailing backward integration plans.
Solex Energy received Top Performer recognition in the Kiwa PVEL 2026 PV Module Reliability Scorecard for its Tapi R and Tapi Trans Dual module series.
October 16, 2026: Solex Energy said the proposed promoter-group Shareholders' Agreement intimated on April 17, 2026 was never executed and lapsed on expiry of its tenure.
October 19, 2026: Solex New Energy, the wholly owned subsidiary, approved issuing ₹150 Cr of CCDs convertible into Solex Energy equity, subject to the holding company board's approval.
Solex Energy unveiled its N-Type TOP-Con Quarter Cell Solar Module TAPI RQ at the REI Expo 2026.
